title: Cashing Out Your Old 401k Costs You $152,000
hook: 35% of workers cash out their 401k when they switch jobs — and that one impulsive decision quietly destroys over $150,000 in future wealth.
angle: The 30% immediate penalty feels bad enough — but the real damage is the compounding growth you forfeit, which dwarfs the tax hit by a factor of ten.
audience: Job-hoppers in their 20s–40s who've left behind old retirement accounts without rolling them over
key_numbers: 35% of job switchers cash out their 401k instead of rolling it over
30% immediate hit from the 10% early withdrawal penalty plus federal tax
$20,000 cashed out today grows to $152,000 in 30 years at 7% — money you can never get back
